title: Jurassic flightless bird reveals early ecological diversity of avialans
title_zh: 侏罗飞不了的鸟揭示早期鸟形类的生态多样性
abstract: The origin and early diversification of birds remain highly debated in vertebrate evolution. Although estimates of the evolutionary timescales suggest a Jurassic period radiation1,2, a profound scarcity of fossils from this period has hampered how the distinctive bird bauplan was assembled3–5. Selection for powered flight has been viewed as the primary driver of early avialan skeletal modifications3,6,7, attesting to the independent occurrences of aerodynamic features among paravian lineages8. Here we report on the discovery of a Late Jurassic avialan, Yuezhuornis yangyuanensis, gen. et sp. nov., from the Zhenghe Fauna of southeastern China9. As one of the earliest diverging avialans, Y. yangyuanensis exhibits a striking mosaic of features, combining a mixture of avialan- and troodontid-like cranial characters, paired with derived postcranial traits and a deinonychosaur-like hyperextensible second pedal digit. Phylogenetically informed analyses show that Y. yangyuanensis possesses markedly short forelimbs—a condition present widely among non-avialan theropods. These findings provide strong evidence for a terrestrial, flightless lifestyle of Y. yangyuanensis. Our study demonstrates that evolution works intensively as exemplified by the occurrence of several, divergent ecological pathways being exploited in the initial diversification of birds. A fossil bird from the Upper Jurassic Zhenghe Fauna of southeastern China contemporary with Archaeopteryx and that clearly could not fly sheds new light on the ecological diversification of early-diverging avialans.
abstract_zh: 鸟类的起源及早期辐射仍是脊椎动物进化中的热门议题。尽管进化时间尺度的估计表明始新世/侏罗纪早期出现了放射性分化1,2，但该时期化石的严重匮乏阻碍了我们了解典型鸟形体如何组装3–5。人们普遍认为，为动力飞行而进行的选择是早期鸟形类骨骼修饰的主要驱动力3,6,7，这也证明了空气动力特征在鸟形类近缘线中的独立出现8。本研究报道了从中国东南部郑和动物群发现的始新世/侏罗纪晚期鸟形类Yuezhuornis yangyuanensis，属及种新9。作为早期分化的鸟形类，Y. yangyuanensis呈现出显著的 mosaic 特征，其头骨特征兼具鸟形类和近鸟龙的特征，而躯干具有衍生特征，第二脚趾呈近似近鸟龙的可弯曲状态。在系统发育信息分析中显示，Y. yangyuanensis 具有明显短小的前肢——这一特征在非鸟形类恐龙中普遍存在。这些发现为 Y. yangyuanensis 的陆生、不会飞的生活方式提供了有力证据。我们的研究表明，进化过程充满活力，这体现在早期鸟类分化过程中利用了多条不同的生态途径。来自郑和动物群的始新世/侏罗纪晚期化石与始祖鸟同时代，且显然不会飞，这为早期鸟形类的生态辐射提供了新的视角。
